name: smara-docs-site-agent
description: Custom workflow untuk maintenance dan deployment Smara docs site: audit konten, sync versi, build VitePress, verifikasi, dan deploy ke Vercel.

agents.description: Mengaudit konsistensi docs site: cek file yang ada vs sidebar config, broken links, dan version mismatch.

tasks.description: Audit file docs, cek kelengkapan halaman, dan deteksi inkonsistensi.

tool_args.command:
set -e
cd "/home/cahya/2026/Smara CLI"
VERSION=$(cat VERSION)
DOCS="docs-site"

echo "=== Docs Site Audit ==="
echo "Version: $VERSION"
echo

# 1. Check all sidebar pages exist
echo "--- Sidebar Page Check ---"
CONFIG="$DOCS/.vitepress/config.ts"
MISSING=0
FOUND=0

# Extract all links from sidebar config
LINKS=$(grep -oP "link: '/[^']+'" "$CONFIG" | sed "s/link: '//;s/'//" | sort -u)

for link in $LINKS; do
  # Convert link to file path
  if [ "$link" = "/" ]; then
    FILE="$DOCS/index.md"
  else
    FILE="$DOCS${link}.md"
  fi

  if [ -f "$FILE" ]; then
    FOUND=$((FOUND + 1))
  else
    echo "  ❌ MISSING: $FILE (sidebar link: $link)"
    MISSING=$((MISSING + 1))
  fi
done

echo "  Found: $FOUND pages"
echo "  Missing: $MISSING pages"

# 2. Check for orphaned .md files not in sidebar
echo
echo "--- Orphan Check ---"
SIDEBAR_PATHS=$(echo "$LINKS" | while read l; do
  if [ "$l" = "/" ]; then echo "$DOCS/index.md"
  else echo "$DOCS${l}.md"
  fi
done | sort)

ACTUAL_FILES=$(find "$DOCS" -name '*.md' ! -path '*/node_modules/*' ! -path '*/.vitepress/*' | sort)

ORPHANS=$(comm -23 <(echo "$ACTUAL_FILES") <(echo "$SIDEBAR_PATHS") 2>/dev/null || true)
if [ -n "$ORPHANS" ]; then
  echo "  Orphaned files (exist but not in sidebar):"
  echo "$ORPHANS" | while read f; do echo "    ⚠ $f"; done
else
  echo "  ✓ No orphaned files"
fi

# 3. Check version consistency
echo
echo "--- Version Consistency ---"
DOCS_VERSION=$(node -e "console.log(require('./$DOCS/package.json').version)" 2>/dev/null || echo "unknown")
if [ "$VERSION" = "$DOCS_VERSION" ]; then
  echo "  ✓ VERSION ($VERSION) matches docs-site/package.json"
else
  echo "  ⚠ MISMATCH: VERSION=$VERSION vs docs-site=$DOCS_VERSION"
fi

# Check install scripts reference current version
if grep -q "$VERSION" install.sh 2>/dev/null; then
  echo "  ✓ install.sh references v$VERSION"
else
  echo "  ℹ install.sh uses dynamic version detection"
fi

# 4. Count pages by section
echo
echo "--- Section Summary ---"
for dir in getting-started core-concepts guides reference examples; do
  COUNT=$(find "$DOCS/$dir" -name '*.md' 2>/dev/null | wc -l)
  echo "  $dir: $COUNT pages"
done

# 5. Check for TODO/FIXME/PLACEHOLDER
echo
echo "--- Placeholder Check ---"
PLACEHOLDERS=$(grep -rlE '(TODO|FIXME|PLACEHOLDER|PLACEHOLDER|COMING SOON|Under construction)' "$DOCS" --include='*.md' ! -path '*/node_modules/*' 2>/dev/null | wc -l)
echo "  Pages with placeholders: $PLACEHOLDERS"
if [ "$PLACEHOLDERS" -gt 0 ]; then
  grep -rlE '(TODO|FIXME|PLACEHOLDER|COMING SOON|Under construction)' "$DOCS" --include='*.md' ! -path '*/node_modules/*' 2>/dev/null | while read f; do echo "    ⚠ $f"; done
fi

echo
echo "✅ Docs audit complete"

agents.description: Sinkronisasi versi dari root VERSION ke docs-site/package.json dan pastikan konten docs up-to-date.

tasks.description: Update versi di docs-site dan perbaiki isu yang ditemukan audit.

tool_args.command:
set -e
cd "/home/cahya/2026/Smara CLI"
VERSION=$(cat VERSION)
DOCS="docs-site"

echo "=== Sync Version & Content ==="
echo "Version: $VERSION"

# 1. Sync version to docs-site/package.json
echo
echo "--- Sync package.json version ---"
DOCS_VERSION=$(node -e "console.log(require('./$DOCS/package.json').version)" 2>/dev/null || echo "unknown")
if [ "$VERSION" != "$DOCS_VERSION" ]; then
  node -e "
    const fs = require('fs');
    const pkg = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('$DOCS/package.json', 'utf8'));
    pkg.version = '$VERSION';
    fs.writeFileSync('$DOCS/package.json', JSON.stringify(pkg, null, 2) + '\n');
  "
  echo "  ✓ Updated docs-site/package.json: $DOCS_VERSION → $VERSION"
else
  echo "  ✓ Already in sync: $VERSION"
fi

# 2. Check installation page has correct version
echo
echo "--- Check installation guide ---"
INSTALL_DOC="$DOCS/getting-started/installation.md"
if [ -f "$INSTALL_DOC" ]; then
  if grep -q "$VERSION" "$INSTALL_DOC"; then
    echo "  ✓ Installation guide references v$VERSION"
  else
    echo "  ℹ Installation guide uses generic install commands (OK)"
  fi
fi

# 3. Check index.md
echo
echo "--- Check index page ---"
if [ -f "$DOCS/index.md" ]; then
  WORDS=$(wc -w < "$DOCS/index.md")
  echo "  ✓ index.md: $WORDS words"
fi

echo
echo "✅ Version sync complete"

agents.description: Build VitePress docs site dan verifikasi output berhasil.

tasks.description: Install deps dan build VitePress production site.

tool_args.command:
set -e
cd "/home/cahya/2026/Smara CLI/docs-site"

echo "=== Build Docs Site (VitePress) ==="

# Install dependencies
echo "--- Install dependencies ---"
npm install --prefer-offline 2>&1 | tail -5

# Build
echo
echo "--- Build VitePress ---"
npm run docs:build 2>&1

# Verify output
echo
echo "--- Verify Build Output ---"
DIST=".vitepress/dist"
if [ ! -d "$DIST" ]; then
  echo "❌ FAIL: Build output directory not found: $DIST"
  exit 1
fi

# Count output files
HTML_COUNT=$(find "$DIST" -name '*.html' | wc -l)
JS_COUNT=$(find "$DIST" -name '*.js' | wc -l)
CSS_COUNT=$(find "$DIST" -name '*.css' | wc -l)

echo "  ✓ Output directory: $DIST"
echo "  ✓ HTML pages: $HTML_COUNT"
echo "  ✓ JS files: $JS_COUNT"
echo "  ✓ CSS files: $CSS_COUNT"

# Check index.html exists
if [ -f "$DIST/index.html" ]; then
  echo "  ✓ index.html exists"
  INDEX_SIZE=$(wc -c < "$DIST/index.html")
  echo "  ✓ index.html size: $INDEX_SIZE bytes"
else
  echo "  ❌ FAIL: index.html missing"
  exit 1
fi

# Check 404 page
if [ -f "$DIST/404.html" ]; then
  echo "  ✓ 404.html exists"
fi

# Total size
TOTAL_SIZE=$(du -sh "$DIST" | cut -f1)
echo "  ✓ Total build size: $TOTAL_SIZE"

echo
echo "✅ Docs build successful"

agents.description: Verifikasi kualitas build: cek broken internal links, missing assets, dan validasi HTML.

tasks.description: Quality gate: broken links, missing images, dan HTML validation.

tool_args.command:
set +e
cd "/home/cahya/2026/Smara CLI/docs-site"
DIST=".vitepress/dist"

echo "=== Docs Quality Verification ==="

ISSUES=0

# 1. Check broken internal links
echo "--- Broken Link Check ---"
BROKEN=0
# Extract all href from built HTML files
grep -roh 'href="/[^"]*"' "$DIST" 2>/dev/null | sed 's/href="//;s/"//' | sort -u | while read link; do
  # Remove anchor
  path=$(echo "$link" | sed 's/#.*//')
  if [ -z "$path" ] || [ "$path" = "/" ]; then continue; fi

  # Check if file exists
  FILE="${DIST}${path}"
  FILE_INDEX="${DIST}${path}/index.html"
  FILE_HTML="${DIST}${path}.html"

  if [ ! -f "$FILE" ] && [ ! -f "$FILE_INDEX" ] && [ ! -f "$FILE_HTML" ]; then
    echo "  ⚠ Broken link: $link"
    BROKEN=$((BROKEN + 1))
  fi
done

if [ "$BROKEN" -eq 0 ]; then
  echo "  ✓ No broken internal links detected"
fi

# 2. Check missing images/assets
echo
echo "--- Missing Asset Check ---"
IMG_REFS=$(grep -roh 'src="/[^"]*"' "$DIST" 2>/dev/null | sed 's/src="//;s/"//' | sort -u)
MISSING_ASSETS=0
for img in $IMG_REFS; do
  if [ ! -f "${DIST}${img}" ]; then
    echo "  ⚠ Missing asset: $img"
    MISSING_ASSETS=$((MISSING_ASSETS + 1))
  fi
done
if [ "$MISSING_ASSETS" -eq 0 ]; then
  echo "  ✓ All referenced assets found"
fi

# 3. Check for empty pages
echo
echo "--- Empty Page Check ---"
EMPTY=0
find "$DIST" -name '*.html' | while read html; do
  CONTENT_SIZE=$(wc -c < "$html")
  if [ "$CONTENT_SIZE" -lt 500 ]; then
    echo "  ⚠ Suspiciously small: $html ($CONTENT_SIZE bytes)"
    EMPTY=$((EMPTY + 1))
  fi
done
if [ "$EMPTY" -eq 0 ]; then
  echo "  ✓ No empty/suspiciously small pages"
fi

# 4. Check sitemap
echo
echo "--- Sitemap Check ---"
if [ -f "$DIST/sitemap.xml" ]; then
  URLS=$(grep -c '<loc>' "$DIST/sitemap.xml" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
  echo "  ✓ sitemap.xml: $URLS URLs"
else
  echo "  ℹ No sitemap.xml (VitePress may not generate by default)"
fi

echo
echo "✅ Docs quality verification complete"

agents.description: Deploy docs site: commit perubahan dan push ke trigger Vercel auto-deploy, atau deploy via Vercel CLI.

tasks.description: Commit dan push perubahan docs untuk trigger Vercel deployment.

tool_args.command:
set -e
cd "/home/cahya/2026/Smara CLI"
VERSION=$(cat VERSION)

echo "=== Deploy Docs Site ==="
echo "Version: $VERSION"

# 1. Check for changes
echo
echo "--- Git Status ---"
git add docs-site/
git status --short docs-site/

CHANGES=$(git diff --cached --stat docs-site/ 2>/dev/null | tail -1)
if [ -z "$CHANGES" ] && [ -z "$(git status --porcelain docs-site/)" ]; then
  echo "  ℹ No changes in docs-site to deploy"
  echo "  Vercel will serve the latest already-deployed version."
  echo
echo "✅ Nothing to deploy (no changes)"
  exit 0
fi

echo "  Changes: $CHANGES"

# 2. Commit
echo
echo "--- Commit ---"
git commit -m "docs: update docs site v${VERSION}

- Synced version with root VERSION
- Rebuilt VitePress output
- Audit and quality checks passed" 2>/dev/null || echo "  ℹ Nothing new to commit"

# 3. Push
echo
echo "--- Push to Remote ---"
git push origin HEAD 2>&1
echo "  ✓ Pushed to origin"

# 4. Check Vercel deploy status
echo
echo "--- Vercel Deploy ---"
if command -v vercel >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "  Vercel CLI detected. Checking deployment..."
  vercel ls 2>&1 | head -5 || true
else
  echo "  ℹ Vercel CLI not installed"
  echo "  Vercel auto-deploy will trigger from push."
  echo "  Check: https://vercel.com/dashboard"
fi

echo
echo "✅ Docs deployment initiated"
echo "  Site: Check Vercel dashboard or project URL"
echo "  Trigger: git push to origin"
